payload.text: AT-00.3's macOS half, ruled at cc's ask (2026-11-03 09:40Z). No fileicon on the macOS runner: a brew install on every run adds a CI dependency, against hv's simpler-or-easier rule, and tests.yml's header says why the icon tests skip there. The macOS evidence is a local bin/devbin test shell on a Mac that has fileicon, where the only skip is the AC-00.7 Linux test, by design. Both halves measure the same code. vc's pre-push verification of main in a fresh clone gives the macOS run, and CI's ubuntu run on hv's push gives the Linux half. The row cites the commit and the run id. cc's AT-id commit 7afa8a9 is reviewed: comments only, each in at lint's literal form. It is measured with main before the push.
